registry_row_schema_source: key set of qamus/skills/rule-registry.jsonl rows (current main); validated field-for-field by tools/validate_curriculum_l1l6.py

rich_hover_fields.teaching: names the matched row with its form number, tense and stem class, and states which vowels are the exponent
on a colliding cell, shows the rival active and passive rows side by side and says the letters do not settle it — the abstention is displayed as the answer, not as a failure
highlights the cells where the melody changes a LETTER, so the reader learns which cells survive unvocalised text
states plainly when the stem class has no row in this pack, instead of stretching a sound-stem melody over it

rollback_condition: revert to unit-v1.json (kept committed; the loops manifest pins both packs), rerun the regression command, expect the recorded pre-repair defect set
